case.question: Which portfolios have never had their performance recorded?
case.reference_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_id NOT IN (SELECT portfolio_id FROM portfolio_performance);

result.question: Which portfolios have never had their performance recorded?
result.message: Returns the names of portfolios that do not have any entries in the portfolio_performance table.
result.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p WHERE p.portfolio_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT portfolio_id FROM portfolio_performance)

attempts.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p WHERE p.portfolio_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT portfolio_id FROM portfolio_performance)
attempts.explanation: Returns the names of portfolios that do not have any entries in the portfolio_performance table.
